levels.capacity: buffers allocate, the context object accepts the length
levels.addressing: RoPE / KV / position arithmetic is tested at that absolute range

levels.note: the three are never collapsed; a capacity PASS is not an end-to-end claim

kv_model.derivation: 4 kv heads x 256 head dim x 2 bytes x (K + V) = 8192, matching layout.kv_row
kv_model.formula: container + kv_row*16*ctx + ptab_row*ctx + globals + linear_state + per-layer buffers

rows.notes: 4095 engine tokens = 15 full blocks + a padded 255 tail; 4096 engine tokens is REFUSED by a one-token off-by-one in the length guard (0 tokens prefilled)

addressing_detail.rope_reference: cos/sin(pos * inv_freq[i]) in float64 against the f32 the engine wrote
addressing_detail.record_valid_rule: valid = pos - start (stream_patch::attn_window), so a full causal window gives valid == pos

attention_gate.source: engine-internal accounting, block route, 4000 ids, 16 blocks
attention_gate.model: attention per block = 1.628 ms/position x position + 187 ms   (R^2 = 0.99768, 15 full blocks)
attention_gate.why_it_matters: attention is linear in position while GEMM is linear in BLOCKS, so attention's share grows quadratically in context length: 12.3% at 4K, 21.5% at 8K, 35.1% at 16K
attention_gate.decision: STOP full-context escalation; report attention as the selected next target

max_prefill_len.reason: 8K/16K did not pass the end-to-end gate, so there is no evidence to raise it; the value must follow a validated prefill, not a capacity PASS

default_context_length.note: a context longer than default_context_length is requestable with --ctx-len; the 256K capacity is available without making it the default, and KV at 256K is 32 GiB
default_context_length.recommendation: leave 32768; a 256K default would allocate 32 GiB of KV for every request that asked for it

failure_behaviour.over_capacity: explicit '[WARNING] Max length reached, stopping prefilling...' and nothing prefilled
failure_behaviour.observed: engine 4096 at a 4096 capacity is refused outright; engine 4095 runs (16 passes)
